title: 收藏对象 ID 化（P2-05）
review: docs/features/favorites.md — 收藏身份 (email, org_id, obj_id)，移动/重命名跟随对象
comment: channel=api，由 favorites_matrix.py 断言；开启 CF_ENABLE_FAVORITES_ID 时运行。关闭开关时的原生 CE 收藏行为由基线 smoke 覆盖。

cases.name: star a file and list it back
cases.review: 收藏后可列举且路径可解析
cases.expect: starring /fav.txt succeeds and the starred list contains repo_id + /fav.txt

cases.name: starred item follows a move by object id
cases.expect: after moving /fav.txt to /dest/fav.txt the starred item shows /dest/fav.txt and the old path is gone
